{{short description|Hungarian mathematician}}
'''György Alexits''' (5 January 1899 - 14 October 1978), born in [[Budapest]], was a [[List of Hungarian mathematicians|Hungarian mathematician]], and a member of the [[Hungarian Academy of Sciences]].

Alexits is the author of ''Konvergenzprobleme der Orthogonalreihen'' (1960), translated as ''Convergence Problems of Orthogonal Series'' (Pergamon, 1961).
